item.title: UK Unemployment Rate rises to 5.2% vs. 5.1% estimates
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) ILO Unemployment Rate jumps to 5.2% in the three months ending in December from estimates and the previous reading of 5.1%. Fresh workers added in the period were 52K, lower than 82K in three months ending in November.
